motions.item_title: Approve a resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, adopting an Ofjicial A…
motions.motion: Board Member Gray moved to approve a resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, adopting an Ofjicial Amended Project Area PIan for the Sweetwater Industrial Park Community Reinvestment Project Area #3. Bourd Member Curtis seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Sweetwater Industrial Park plan amended
motions.summary: Alongside the budget, the agency board adopted an amended plan for the Sweetwater Industrial Park project area, the document describing what the agency intends to do there.
motions.impact: Residents living elsewhere in Eagle Mountain will not feel this. Anyone with land or a business in the Sweetwater area should read the amended plan, since it sets what the agency can do there.

motions.item_title: Approve a resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, adopting the Amended P…
motions.motion: Board Member Gray moved to approve a resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, adopting the Amended Project Area Budget for the Sweetwater Industrial Park Community Reinvestment Project Area #3. Board Member Curtis seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Sweetwater Industrial Park budget amended
motions.summary: The agency board adopted an amended budget for its Sweetwater Industrial Park project area, the account that governs how property tax growth there is spent.
motions.impact: No figures were read into the motion, so the size of the change is not on the record. The land is industrial, not housing: businesses and developers building there are the ones affected.

motions.item_title: Approve a resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, approving an Amended I…
motions.motion: Board Member Gray moved to approve a resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, approving an Amended Interlocal Cooperation Agreement between the Eagle Mountain Redevelopment Agency and Eagle Mountain City for the collection and remittance of Incremental Property Taxes collected from property within the Sweetwater Industrial Park Community Reinvestment Project Area #3. Board Member Curtis seconded the motion. No Abstaining
motions.headline: How Sweetwater tax money reaches the agency
motions.summary: The agency board signed off on an updated agreement with the city covering how property tax growth inside the Sweetwater Industrial Park area is collected and handed over.
motions.impact: Your tax bill does not change. This is an accounting arrangement between the agency and the city for money already being collected in an industrial area, and you will not see it.
